description: This file defines the WebKit class extending BrowserType, implementing methods for connecting, environment setup, logging, closing, and argument generation for WebKit browser instances within the Playwright project. It also includes a utility function for translating paths to WSL.

classes.name: WebKit
classes.description: Represents the WebKit browser type, providing methods to connect, configure environment, handle logs, close, and generate startup arguments for WebKit browsers.

methods.name: connectToTransport
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a WebKit browser via transport.

methods.name: amendEnvironment
methods.description: Modifies environment variables for WebKit browser startup.

methods.name: doRewriteStartupLog
methods.description: Rewrites startup logs, especially handling display errors.

methods.name: attemptToGracefullyCloseBrowser
methods.description: Sends a message to close the browser gracefully.

methods.name: defaultArgs
methods.description: Generates default command-line arguments for launching WebKit, considering options like headless mode, user data directory, proxy settings, and platform specifics.
